materials.name: Rift Shard
materials.description: Crystallized mana from sky fractures. Unstable alone; rune-bound in Marcus Vale's workshops it becomes the foundation of post-Rapture mana-tech.

materials.name: Storm Crystal
materials.description: Lightning-charged crystal harvested from Thunder Stag territories. Holds charge longer than rift shards; required for high-amplitude spell foci.

materials.name: Memory Glass Shard
materials.description: Forgotten Palace glass that stores emotional residue. Dangerous to handle unwarded; essential for memory-protection gear and advanced wards.

materials.name: Echo Crystal
materials.description: Resonant crystal formed where dungeon echoes pool. Amplifies rune repetition and communication arrays.

materials.name: Beast Core (E)
materials.description: Condensed mana organ from low-tier beasts. Purified and ground, it stabilizes crystal matrices so enchantments do not collapse on first use.

materials.name: Beast Core (D)
materials.description: Denser core from mid-tier predators. Binds rune ink to steel and leather; standard for Iron Guild field gear.

materials.name: Beast Core (C)
materials.description: High-pressure mana nucleus. Required for spell staves and cloaks that channel affinity without burning the wielder's channels.

materials.name: Beast Core (B)
materials.description: Elite core from settlement-tier threats. One core can anchor a squad's barrier net or a single masterwork enchantment.

materials.name: Beast Core (A)
materials.description: Regional-threat core. Rarely traded openly; Sanctuary council licenses required for civilian use.

materials.name: Beast Core (S)
materials.description: Sovereign-grade nucleus. Not craft fodder — story-bound relics and national assets. Mishandling causes catastrophic mana backlash.

recipes.name: Basic Mana Cell
recipes.description: Portable mana battery for explorers. Marcus Vale's first scalable product — proof that crystals and cores can rebuild civilization.

recipes.name: Rune-Forged Blade
recipes.description: Steel blade with a rift-shard channel and D-rank core binder. Channels low-cost techniques and Ember Strike without shattering the edge.

recipes.name: Storm Crystal Staff
recipes.description: Lightning focus staff. Storm crystal provides amplitude; C-rank core prevents feedback into the wielder's channels.

recipes.name: Ember Hide Jacket
recipes.description: Light armor from Ashwolf hide. E-rank core binds ember-resist runes into the leather grain.

recipes.name: Void Silk Cloak
recipes.description: Stealth weave from Whisper Shade silk. Core stabilizes void-silk so the cloak does not whisper back to its wearer.

recipes.name: Memory Glass Amulet
recipes.description: Forgotten Palace expedition gear. Memory glass stores ward-pattern; B-rank core keeps personal memories from leaking into the crystal.

recipes.name: Rune Light Node
recipes.description: Infrastructure rune plate for settlement lighting. Rift shard provides steady mana drip; E-core anchors the engraving.

recipes.name: Healing Salve
recipes.description: Field medicine — not Lifefire, but stabilizes wounds until a healer arrives. Purified E-core carries restorative mana without live channel contact.

recipes.name: Roc Wing Bow
recipes.description: Nora Winters' intended masterwork. Roc plume and A-rank core let arrows ride wind-currents shaped by Horizon Sight.

recipes.name: Enchant Weapon Rite
recipes.description: Temporary mana channel on any blade. Requires rift-shard dust and a spent D-core — standard Sanctuary forge commission.
